meta.description: ChaSet unified design tokens. Three tiers: primitives (scales), semantic (aliased roles, per-product presets), composite (multi-part surfaces, platform-gated). Two product presets: 'launcher' (crd-a launcher, shadcn/Tailwind v4, oklch) and 'dunting' (dt-a Qt/QML ThemeManager palette). Values are transcribed verbatim from product sources; nothing is invented or normalized.

excluded.accentHover/accentPressed: runtime-derived in theme_manager.cpp:132-134 (accent().lighter(112)/darker(110)); never static tokens
excluded.tabMinWidth/tabMaxWidth: user preferences, not design tokens (theme_manager_test.cpp owns them)

sources.launcher.composites: crd-a/launcher/src/css/app-variables.css (:root lines 1-66 light/base, .dark lines 67-111 dark overrides)
sources.launcher.semantic-defaults: crd-a/launcher/src/css/shadcn-base.css (:root light block lines 104-141, .dark block lines 143-179)
sources.launcher.window-tints: crd-a/launcher/src/css/window-tint.css (12 selector blocks: 6 light :root[data-window-tint], 6 dark .dark[data-window-tint]; tint ids slate/graphite/mist/sage/plum/custom)

mappings.dunting-to-core.border: border (+input, inherited - dunting defines no separate input token)

reclassifications: app-status-success/warning/error stay in composite.launcher under their original --app-* names (consumers reference them by those names; tiering follows source fidelity)
--hover (shadcn-base.css) merged with dunting hover into semantic.interaction.hover (same role)

conventions.colors.dunting: #RRGGBBAA hex rendered from QColor::fromRgbF(r,g,b,a) via channel*255 rounded half-away-from-zero once (Qt 8-bit quantization); opaque colors carry 'ff'. Conversion table: .omo/evidence/t1/conversion-table.md
conventions.colors.launcher: verbatim oklch()/color-mix()/var() strings from css sources
conventions.composite.shape: { "$platform": ["css"], "light"?: string, "dark"?: string }; a part present in one mode only appears in that mode only
conventions.inheritance: preset values absent from a source are inherited from the token's base and flagged "inherited": true
conventions.keys: custom property names stored WITHOUT leading '--'; generators re-add it
conventions.overrides.shape: { selector (verbatim from source css), preset, axes..., tokens: { name: value } }

inherited.dunting: aliases border; dunting defines no separate input token

app-window-background.dark: linear-gradient(135deg, color-mix(in oklch, var(--app-window-tint) 92%, white 8%), var(--app-window-tint))
app-window-background.light: linear-gradient(135deg, color-mix(in oklch, var(--app-window-tint) 96%, white 4%), var(--app-window-tint))

app-window-tint-overlay.dark: linear-gradient(135deg, color-mix(in oklch, var(--app-window-tint) 45%, transparent), color-mix(in oklch, var(--app-window-tint) 50%, transparent))
app-window-tint-overlay.light: linear-gradient(135deg, color-mix(in oklch, var(--app-window-tint) 30%, transparent), color-mix(in oklch, var(--app-window-tint) 35%, transparent))

app-modal-shadow.dark: 0 1.5rem 4rem color-mix(in oklch, black 38%, transparent), 0 0.125rem 0.75rem color-mix(in oklch, black 20%, transparent), inset 0 0.0625rem 0 color-mix(in oklch, white 11%, transparent)
app-modal-shadow.light: 0 1.375rem 3.625rem color-mix(in oklch, var(--foreground) 16%, transparent), 0 0.125rem 0.625rem color-mix(in oklch, var(--foreground) 8%, transparent), inset 0 0.0625rem 0 color-mix(in oklch, white 42%, transparent)

app-menu-texture.dark: linear-gradient(125deg, color-mix(in oklch, var(--popover) 96%, white 4%) 0%, var(--popover) 50%, color-mix(in oklch, var(--popover) 93%, var(--primary) 7%) 100%)
app-menu-texture.light: linear-gradient(125deg, color-mix(in oklch, var(--popover) 95%, white 5%) 0%, var(--popover) 48%, color-mix(in oklch, var(--popover) 95%, var(--primary) 5%) 100%)

qt.note: dunting preset flattened for generate-qt.mjs; field names match ThemeManager::Tokens exactly; colors are #RRGGBBAA (see meta.conventions.colors.dunting); accentHover/accentPressed intentionally absent (runtime-derived)
